snippet.title: Livin' the Cream - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Welcome to Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator!🍦 

Build your own ice cream business and turn a small shop into a local favorite. Create delicious ice cream, serve customers, manage your supplies, customize your shop and expand your business.

🍨 Mix flavors, experiment with toppings and keep your customers happy as you work your way to becoming the ultimate ice cream entrepreneur!

Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator is coming to Steam in Q4 2026!

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4621810/Livin_the_Cream_Ice_Cream_Simulator/
